regime_context: Hong Kong thematic breadth is very narrow: only 3 of 17 themes are absolute-trend eligible (Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates & Exchange), and the rotation read is directional=false. Banks lead with the strongest durability (0.69) and breadth (0.769) but have no ETF proxy, so the one scorable candidate (China Tech 3033.HK) is NOT among the eligible leaders — this materially limits what can be cleanly graded. The gate_helps flag is true, so trend discipline has historically cut drawdown here, but I still express no directional certainty.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the narrow eligible set (Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates) expands beyond 3 of 17 themes: if breadth_of_rotation.frac moves from 0.18 toward 0.30 on unchanged benchmark price, the leadership concentration is broadening and the Banks-only conviction would need to be revisited.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the top theme on the focus rank (1.383) and the only eligible leader with both strong durability (0.69) and broad participation (breadth 0.769), consistent with a staying-power rather than call-alpha read. With the absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown control and this theme eligible, the lean is a modest directional preference, not a prediction of outperformance. Unscorable (no ETF proxy), so conviction stays low.
evidence: gate_helps=true supports low drawdown discipline on this theme
theses.dissent: Banks lead the broad Hang Seng and this leadership may simply mirror a market-level China policy/geopolitics bid (macro_narrative shows ai_tech and geopolitics tied for most dominant headlines) rather than a bank-specific fundamental story; a narrow 3-theme eligible set with leader breadth already elevated can stall without follow-through.

falsifier.text: Banks underperform the Hang Seng by 3% over the next 20 trading days despite an unchanged or rising durability_bar

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech is the only cleanly scorable theme (3033.HK proxy) but sits at rank 13 with a negative score (-0.677), is trend-ineligible, and carries a mean-revert Hurst tag. The detector offers no support for an overweight on the one theme that can be externally graded; the honest conditional is to stay away until it regains trend eligibility or the absolute-trend gate flips.
evidence: only scorable=true proxy in the eligible-adjacent set
theses.dissent: A beaten-down mean-revert theme could snap back hard on a positive China tech policy headline (macro_narrative shows ai_tech as a dominant market-level narrative), making avoidance a potential underweight miss versus the benchmark.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK closes back above its 20-day moving average and the theme's trend-gate eligibility flips to true before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
